# Wiki Markdown emission with OKF-conformant frontmatter

This module takes in Knowledge IR and emits a set of Markdown files (one per knowledge entity) that conform to the OKF specification, including per-entity YAML frontmatter and links across entities. It efficiently handles regeneration, only writing changed pages, and maintains reserved index, log, and recent-changes views across all compiles.
